verdict.rationale: CIPO provides keyless public search: a trademarks Advanced search, patent database search with downloadable office records, and bulk data. Founders can plausibly look up their applications this way, and the trademarks page also publishes forecasted examination wait times. However, no evidence explicitly says these public pages show the current status of a specific filing, and the patent path is routed through the MyCIPO Patents account login rather than a public status page. missing for 10: explicit documentation that public search results show application/case status, coverage of status lookup for industrial designs/copyright, independent or hands-on corroboration.
